rss: Minimum wage set to rise but 18-20 year-olds will not get bigger increase
title: Wages Rising for Toy Store Workers
story: Toy store workers are getting a raise! But workers who are 18-20 years old will get a smaller raise.
storyBig: Toy store workers are set to receive an increased minimum wage, boosting their income. However, employees aged 18-20 will not see as significant an increase, raising discussions about fair wage distribution.
think: Why do you think some workers get bigger raises than others?
bull: More money for workers means more toys bought!
bear: Some workers may feel it's unfair they get less raise.

rss: Rise in sales of radios and tinned foods, say retailers, after call to stock up
title: People Stock Up on Snacks and Toys
story: People are buying lots of snacks and toys to be ready for anything! This means more candy and board games are flying off the shelves.
storyBig: A surge in consumer demand for long-lasting snacks and toys is evident as people prepare for potential shortages. Retailers report notable increases in candy and board game sales, indicating shifts in consumer behavior.
think: Why do you think people are buying extra snacks and toys?
bull: Companies selling snacks and toys could earn more money!
bear: If they run out, people might not find what they want in stores.
